description: A large icebreaker ship with a rust-red hull and white-trimmed bow pushes through broken ice floes in dark polar water. Its tall superstructure has a lattice mast, a round funnel-like housing and rows of portholes, suggesting a mid-20th-century steel vessel. Dark stormy clouds fill the sky and snowy mountains sit at the horizon on both sides. No text, letters or frame are visible, and the painting runs edge to edge. Nothing is graphic.
